description: Runs one read-only operation of the Chain Daddy REST API, documented at https://docs.chaindaddy.io/api-reference/explorer (OpenAPI: https://docs.chaindaddy.io/openapi.yaml), by its tool name and arguments, and returns the API's JSON answer. An operation marked as needing sign-in requires Sign in with Chain Daddy and reads only the signed-in user's own data.

arguments.description: The operation's arguments, matching its input schema. Omit or {} when it takes none.

tool.description: The read-only operation's tool name, as the operation search lists it.

name: call_read_operation
title: Run a read operation
